text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Today, I was going over strategy with 
Seiun Sky for tomorrow's mock race.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Pretend my balance is faltering on the 
turn. Intentionally lose at the end to 
lower their guard—

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, the simulation went perfectly~. This 
should make for some great bait♪
choice_data_list:
This is all preparation to win when it 
counts.

This is all preparation to win when it 
counts, right?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
"Exactly. ...Well then, now that 
everything's settled, Sei-chan will be 
taking her afternoon nap—"

text_block_list.name: Senior Trainer
text_block_list.text: I'm coming in.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Wh-Whoa?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The one asking was a senior trainer in 
charge of tomorrow's rival Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Senior Trainer
text_block_list.text:
"...I came to talk about tomorrow. What 
was that about a 'nap'?"

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Ehh, taking a nap? No way! Ahaha, you 
must've misheard~.

text_block_list.name: Senior Trainer
text_block_list.text:
Good grief... Hey, this lack of focus, 
isn't it largely due to your poor 
leadership?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
...Ah, no no no. See, this person right 
here, no matter how much I say I'm gonna 
slack off, they never listen—
choice_data_list:
I'm sorry, it's because I wasn't good 
enough.

I'm sorry, it's because of my lack of 
ability...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
If the goal is to "lull them into a false 
sense of security," then being 
underestimated is more than welcome. With 
that thought, Seiun Sky was checked with a 
stern glance.

text_block_list.name: Senior Trainer
text_block_list.text:
Let me tell you something: you don't 
understand the first thing about what it 
means to be a Trainer. The Umamusume under 
your care is truly unfortunate.

text_block_list.name: Senior Trainer
text_block_list.text:
"...Depending on tomorrow's results, you'd 
better start thinking about your future."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Having said their piece, the senior 
Trainer walked away.
choice_data_list:
I wonder if I helped with the 'letting 
your guard down' part too?

Did I manage to help you "let your guard 
down" too?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: ...Well, yes.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so came the day of the mock race, but 
when Seiun Sky showed up on the track—

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Sorry to keep you waiting~
choice_data_list: You came here in your racing outfit!?
You came in your racing outfit!?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
I look all fired up, don't I? It's all to 
ensure this strategy goes off without a 
hitch.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: ...And remember, this is a 'switch.'

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Oops, see you later!

text_block_list.name: Senior Trainer
text_block_list.text: Hey, are you ready? ...Let's begin.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"And with both sides loaded into the 
gate... ...the race is underway!!"

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: ...Whoa!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
True to plan, Seiun Sky casts out her 
bait— letting her core wobble around the 
corner.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Lead on the straight, get caught, and lose 
in the end to lure them into a false sense 
of security. That was the plan, but—

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
choice_data_list: (Huh!?)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Seiun Sky held onto the lead brilliantly 
all the way to victory.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Whew, I'm exhausted... That was a really 
close race.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Whew, that was close, so close. I really 
need to work on my cornering... My usual 
'thing' reared its head again.

text_block_list.name: Senior Trainer
text_block_list.text:
"...Well, well, I was thoroughly outdone 
today. You two are somewhat capable after 
all, aren't you?"

text_block_list.name: Senior Trainer
text_block_list.text:
However, the actual race won't necessarily 
yield the same result. We've gained a 
"bountiful harvest" on our end as well, 
after all. Hehe... Until next time.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Heh heh heh... "A good haul", huh~ Well, 
that's great to hear.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
She took the bait nicely. Heh, as expected 
of Sei-chan!
choice_data_list: ...Wasn't the plan to lose?
...Wasn't the plan to lose?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: ...Ah, hmm.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: I accidentally won. Teehee☆

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Seiun Sky is playing the fool. But perhaps 
the reason she didn't stick to the plan 
was—
choice_data_list: Thank you.
I've gotta work harder, too!
I need to work even harder too!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Seiun Sky is playing the fool. But perhaps 
the reason she didn't stick to the plan 
was—
choice_data_list: Thank you.
I've gotta work harder, too!
I need to work even harder too!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
"...Ehh? Sei-chan has no idea what you're 
thanking her for~."

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
More importantly! Since I won fair and 
square, don't I deserve a reward?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Make it something nice, like: "Great job! 
Today's your day off~!"♪
choice_data_list: Any day other than my day off, please.
Any day other than my day off, please.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Mmmph, so selfish~. You gotta take good 
care of your cute trainee horse girl!
choice_data_list: Yeah.
That's true.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
...Wait, I was totally waiting for you to 
call me out on that.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Wait, Trainer... Are you smirking for some 
reason?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
An elusive girl drifting like a cloud— 
even so, I found myself wanting to 
understand Seiun Sky more and more.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Geh-geh. Why does she have to get so fired 
up right there?
choice_data_list: I want to help you win even more!
And I want to help you win more and more!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Jeez, Trainer, really...

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
...Well, I guess I can hang out with you 
just for today.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—Let us swear to this sky once more. That 
Seiun Sky and I will sprint through the 
Twinkle Series and claim victory...!!
